chapter_title_en: The Ancient Battlefield: Curses, Omens, and the Dream Flower's Root
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality 612: Curse Trap and Visions of the Stone Steps
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen's group encounters a fake petrified beast, survives a massive curse trap, and discovers a withered Dream Flower root. Then they witness apocalyptic visions of the Ninety-Nine Stone Steps and Heavenly Steles.
og_title: WIM 612: Petrified Beast, Curse Trap, and the Dream Flower Root
og_description: A fake stone beast lures our heroes into a deadly curse formation, but the mysterious stone jar absorbs all. A withered root appears, and visions of the Ninety-Nine Steps and Heavenly Steles haunt the sky.
twitter_title: WIM 612: Curse Absorption and a Glimpse of the Steps
twitter_description: Xiao Chen uncovers a puppet beast, survives a curse storm, and glimpses the legendary Ninety-Nine Steps. A perfect blend of horror and revelation.
